# actions-warden

> Audit GitHub Actions in one repository or across a GitHub organization, then
> pin, verify, and upgrade dependencies with explicit write authorization.

Requires Node.js 20+. The CLI is non-interactive. `pin` and `upgrade` are
dry-run by default. Normal JSON payloads use `schemaVersion: "1.0"`. Exit code
1 is a completed `FAIL` result to inspect; exit code 2 is an invocation error.
Organization scans default to a guarded scope-keyed JSON report, bounded stdout
receipt, compatible automatic checkpoint/resume state, and stderr-only live
progress while retaining fresh repository tree validation.
They can emit spreadsheet-safe CSV or self-contained HTML reports, split broad
JSON evidence into a compact aggregate plus integrity-manifested repository
artifacts, and compare a compatible prior JSON report without calling missing
or failed repository findings resolved.
For agent-initiated organization scans, pass `--agent-mode` or set
`ACTIONS_WARDEN_CONTEXT=agent` (`ACTIONS_WARDEN_MODE=agent` is a legacy alias).
It disables implicit progress and uses the agent receipt kind while sharing the
normal artifact identity so compatible resume state survives context switches.
Preserve requested scope; do not load the complete report into model context.
